aboutString: I have expertise across multiple domains of computer science, including Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Full Stack Web and Software Development, and Database Systems. This diverse skill set allows me to integrate technologies effectively. I am highly adaptable to new technical skills and emerging industry trends. My goal is to contribute with passion and commitment while advancing my career and adding value to the organization.

experienceData.subtitle: Consultant - Cyber Security
experienceData.description:
• Conducted application security testing for a global MNC using tools such as HCL AppScan, Burp Suite, Checkmarx, and Visual Studio.
• Delivered successful Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) projects for global clients, identifying critical vulnerabilities and achieving substantial future cost savings.
• Led a nationwide Vulnerability Management program for a top telecom provider, coordinating with senior stakeholders and automating configuration audits using Python (resulting in a 20% increase in productivity).
• Automated manual security tasks using Python, Pandas, and Numpy, leading to a 40% productivity boost.
• Managed enterprise-wide vulnerability scanning using Nessus, Tenable Security Center, and Linux Shell Scripts, improving cybersecurity practices and increasing client satisfaction by 25%.
• Conducted knowledge-sharing sessions on application security testing and vulnerability management, mentoring 10+ employees.
